description: Step 1. A live chart: the data comes straight from the World Bank API every time the page loads. 'property': '[1]' picks the data out of the API's [metadata, data] response. per_page=100 is needed because the API sends only 50 rows by default (the chart would start in 1976, not 1960).

title.subtitle: Total fertility rate (births per woman). Source: World Bank
